Put the jar in the `mods` folder of a Minecraft 1.7.10 Forge instance (for example GT New Horizons), start the game, join any world and type `/packextract`.

The export lands in `<instance>/.minecraft/pack-extract/<pack name>-<date>/`: items, fluids, images, ore dictionary and recipes (crafting, furnace and every GregTech 5 recipe map with output chances). See the [README](https://github.com/syhros/gtcalc-exporter#readme) for the file formats.

Client-side only: the server does not need it.
